observations: Photo 0 shows the front of an engine with four intake ports, some rust on the block, and a Pepsi bottle in the background.
Photo 1 shows the top and side of the engine, with visible belts, pulleys, and a black plastic cover with '100' printed on it.
Photo 2 shows the front of the engine with a black plastic cover labeled 'OWNER'S' and 'MADE IN' partially visible, along with a yellow dipstick and various hoses and wires.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'SOMTO GREAT'.
The engine appears to be a 4-cylinder inline engine, likely a 2.0L or 2.4L model based on size and design.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the engine block or cover in any photo.
The engine is dirty and shows signs of use, with rust and grime visible.

claims.claim: Very very neat, direct tokumbo engine for Hyundai Elantra 2012/13
claims.evidence: The engine appears used and dirty, with visible rust and grime. No visible Hyundai branding or model-specific markings in any photo. The claim of 'very neat' contradicts the visual evidence.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from a Hyundai Elantra 2012/13
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or cover showing the manufacturer's name and model number, or a VIN tag.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used engine, not a specific Hyundai Elantra model.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running or a close-up of the cylinder head, oil pan, and internal components to check for cracks, wear, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with unknown condition.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number and any damage indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a salvage or accident-damaged engine.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the engine block or cover showing the manufacturer's name and model number.
Photo of the engine's serial number or VIN plate.
Video of the engine running or a close-up of the internal components.
Photo of the vehicle it was removed from, if available.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
